title: Fade [V10]
description: Initial Charlie Handsome version that was played to Kanye, Rick Rubin. and Post Malone. According to Charlie it has a "really abrasive, high-pitched riser sound" that was played it over the sample chop, "a synth bass mixed in with 808s", "a mic’d recording of a bicycle chain as it spins and slows down" that was used as a hi-hat roll, and "a really interesting chord progression" which they didn’t want. Charlie also said that they just wanted "the riffs, the drums, the 808s—so I cut it in. Where the beat switches up, my parts come in there". Charlie was invited to the studio by Che Pope after Che saw that Post Malone was in the studio writing with Ye, as Charlie works heavily with Post.
